bullets.text: Windows 11 Insider Preview Build 27971 Released - New Notification Center features enhance multi-monitor support for users.
Azure Storage Discovery Now Available - This service provides enterprise-wide visibility into data estates for better management.
Cyberattacks Driven by Ransomware - Over half of cyber incidents investigated by Microsoft were financially motivated.
New AI Experiences in Windows 11 - Copilot features enhance productivity and security across the operating system.
Securing AI Agents on Windows - New Copilot Actions enhance productivity while prioritizing security and user control.
Making Every Windows 11 PC an AI PC - New updates integrate powerful AI capabilities into everyday Windows experiences.
Microsoft Named Leader in SIEM - Recognition highlights Microsoft Sentinel's capabilities in modern security operations.
Sora 2 Available in Azure AI Foundry - New video generation model empowers organizations to innovate creatively.
ExCyTIn-Bench for AI Cybersecurity - New benchmarking tool evaluates AI systems in real-world cyber investigations.
Building a Lasting Security Culture - Microsoft emphasizes the importance of security training for all employees.
